en: This is a sepia-toned postcard image showing a white-washed church with a dome and a prominent bell tower topped by a cross. The architecture features arched doorways and windows with a distinct Mediterranean appearance. The church is situated on a raised stone platform, surrounded by a low stone wall, and there is a tree in the foreground. The landscape in the background is hilly and sparse.
